_metadata.description: E-MTB geometry database — all measurements in mm and degrees unless noted.

data_confidence_key.high: Data sourced directly from manufacturer website
data_confidence_key.medium: Data cross-referenced from multiple reliable review sources
data_confidence_key.low: Data from single review source or estimated — verify before use

bikes.notes: Gen 3 geometry unchanged 2023-2024. HTA adjustable 63.0-65.5 via headset cups. BB height ±7mm via flip chip.
Independent adjustments: chainstay 435/444mm, BB ±6mm, HTA ±1° via headset. 840Wh standard.
Discontinued after 2024, replaced by Vala in 2025. S size 27.5 only.
Replaces Heckler. First SCB bike with Horst-link. Size-specific chainstays 440-451mm. 5 sizes S-XXL.
Mino Link flip chip: High (shipped) or Low (-0.4° HTA, -5mm BB). Replaced by Rail+ Gen 5 in 2025.
New platform 2025. S size full 27.5. 40mm reach gap between M and L — no ML. BB 338mm low confirmed.
3-position flip chip: Low 63.5°/Mid 63.9°(shipped)/High 64.2°. ±5mm reach via headset cup.
3-position flip chip Low 63.1°/Mid 63.5°(shipped)/High 63.9°. Plus ±5mm headset cup. Carbon only 2026.
5 sizes inc new ML. Size-specific CS: S/M/ML=455mm, L/XL=465mm. 29" only.
65.5° HTA — 1° steeper than 2025 redesign. 4 sizes only. Per-size reaches not confirmed from manufacturer.
No flip chip — fixed geometry. Mullet conversion via different upper rocker link.
1° slacker HTA vs Gen 2 (63.5° vs 64.0°). 170mm fork vs 160mm. Same chainstay and reaches as Gen 2.
Flip chip: Low 64.1°/High 64.5°. 157mm Super Boost. DW-Link suspension. Mullet conversion in High only.

bikes.motor: Bosch Performance Line CX Race Edition Gen 5
bikes.notes: Same frame reaches as Gen 1. Bosch CX Gen 5 Race Edition, larger 800Wh battery. 157mm Super Boost.
Consolidates LitE and CorE into single Druid E. Trifecta V3 high-pivot. Proportional sizing — CS grows ~15mm per size.
Big-travel sibling to Druid E. 1° slacker HTA (63° vs 64°). Higher BB (340.8mm vs 335.8mm). Proportional sizing.
Recalled Nov 2022 (battery fire risk); relaunched 2025 with aluminium-housed 800Wh battery and EP801. Frame geometry unchanged. Horst-link 4-bar suspension.
Shock hidden inside top tube. Scott TwinLoc 2 remote: 3 suspension modes. Carbon front triangle + alloy rear. Replaced by Gen 2 in 2025.
Completely new chassis — shock integrated upside-down in downtube. Adjustable headset ±0.6°. Per-size reach not confirmed from manufacturer.
Proportional Response Tuned — size-specific suspension kinematics and CS. S size uses 27.5 rear wheel. Carbon front, alloy rear.
Long-travel sibling. HTA 64°, STA 76.5°. CS 452mm all sizes. L reach=476, stack=642, BB=356, wheelbase=1276 confirmed.
FlexPivot carbon chainstay acts as Horst-link. Extremely slack 62.5° HTA. Proportional sizing — size-specific CS. 601Wh. ~19.5-20.6kg.

bikes.geo_adjustability: No flip chip — fixed geometry. No geo adjustment available.
bikes.notes: Trifecta V3 high-pivot four-bar suspension. Proportional (OneRide) sizing. Shock: 210x55mm. Replaced by unified 'Druid E' in 2026. 150mm crank arms.

Shares same frame as Druid CorE. Shorter shock (50mm vs 55mm) for 140mm travel, 600Wh battery, 150mm fork vs 160mm. Reaches 7mm longer than CorE throughout range. S3 reach confirmed at 474mm. Replaced by 'Druid E' in 2026.

sizes.notes: S2 reach estimated at 455mm — not confirmed from manufacturer

bikes.motor: Bosch Performance Line CX / CX Race
bikes.geo_adjustability: No flip chip. Fixed geometry. Mullet (MX) conversion via different upper rocker link.
bikes.notes: MX config geometry: chainstays remain 448mm. Reaches and stacks same as 29" for all sizes. Wheelbase M ≈ 1252mm. MyO configurator allows custom spec/paint.

bikes.geo_adjustability: No flip chip. Fixed geometry. Mullet (MX) conversion via different upper rocker link.
bikes.notes: 1° slacker HTA vs Gen 2 (63.5° vs 64.0°). 170mm fork vs 160mm. Same chainstay 448mm. Reaches unchanged from Gen 2.

bikes.geo_adjustability: Flip chip at lower shock mount: Standard (65.5°) and Low (65.15°, 5mm lower BB, 4mm shorter reach).
bikes.notes: Pre-2025 generation. 65.5° HTA is 1° steeper than 2025 redesign. 4 sizes only (S,M,L,XL — no ML). Specific size reaches NOT confirmed from manufacturer. Retained for historical comparison.

bikes.geo_adjustability: Same ±0.6° adjustable headset as 900 series. Longer fork (170mm vs 150mm) slackens HTA to 64.9° vs 65.8°.
bikes.notes: Same frame as 900 series — only fork length differs (170mm vs 150mm), slackening HTA to 64.9°. ST = Super Trail. Piggyback shock. Geometry values (reach/stack) same frame as 900 series.
